verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Rainforest's managed payfac-as-a-service model, with buy-rate interchange-plus pricing, platform-controlled merchant billing and data ownership/export. Nothing documents a path to graduate into registered payment facilitation without replatforming. The economics and data-export features are adjacent and do not show the progression the story asks for.

support.subject: As a founder, there's a path up the stack — start on the managed model and graduate toward registered payment facilitation with more economics and control, without replatforming
